correctness.rationale: The proof establishes bounded discrepancy with zeros precisely at block boundaries; pure Abelian periodicity forces a constant discrepancy progression. For p=L^t, nonaligned endpoint discrepancy encodes one parent letter, whose base-L digit-column composition is constant iff a coincidence digit occurs. This proves the iff and the sharp power. Exactly (L-1)(2min(a,b))^(t-1) shifts have no such period in the first L^t shifts. Boundary cases t=1, a=b, q=0 and r=0 are included. Replayed finite checker: 4,200 block comparisons and 100 censuses passed.
